The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. "I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember. That's the truth of it."
"What's this about? Don't mind me. Today's just heavy."
"Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing."
"About just sitting with someone — I keep turning it over."
"Back home I was a baker. Doesn't mean much now, does it? Means something. Just not much."
"I hate to ask this, but I can't shake it. I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. I need help. Please."

"About what happened to my taken kin — You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Omer?"
